jobs.title: Azure Backend Engineer – Cloud Native & AI-Assisted Development
jobs.description:
🚀
¿Te unes al reto?

En BIP – xTech estamos buscando a gente con ganas de crecer, aprender y enfrentarse a proyectos tecnológicos de verdad: cloud, datos, IA, seguridad, automatización, DevSecOps, IoT, Industria 4.0… ¡Aquí no te vas a aburrir!

Somos un equipo diverso y con muchas ganas, donde combinamos tecnología con estrategia para ofrecer soluciones top a nuestros clientes. Si te interesa estar en el centro de la transformación digital y construir soluciones cloud modernas sobre Azure, este es tu sitio.

💼
¿Qué harás?

La forma de desarrollar software está cambiando. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code y otros asistentes de IA permiten acelerar enormemente el desarrollo, pero seguimos necesitando buenos ingenieros capaces de diseñar la solución, tomar decisiones técnicas, integrar sistemas y garantizar que el código generado sea mantenible, seguro y esté preparado para producción.

Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con .NET y Azure, acostumbrada a construir APIs, microservicios e integraciones cloud-native.

Trabajarás en soluciones donde Azure es una parte fundamental de la arquitectura, utilizando servicios como AKS, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault o Application Insights, entre otros.

Y queremos que la IA forme parte de tu forma habitual de desarrollar: desde generar y refactorizar código hasta crear tests, documentación, revisar implementaciones o acelerar la resolución de problemas.

✅
Lo que necesitamos de ti

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con .NET, con especial foco en:

· Desarrollo .NET / C#: experiencia sólida con .NET moderno, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Dependency Injection, configuración, logging y gestión de errores.

· Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST, incluyendo definición de contratos, versionado, autenticación/autorización, validación y documentación con OpenAPI/Swagger.

· Arquitecturas de microservicios: diseño de servicios desacoplados, comunicación síncrona y asíncrona, resiliencia, observabilidad y gestión de errores.

· Azure Functions: desarrollo de funciones HTTP, event-driven y background processing, incluyendo triggers y bindings.

· Integración en Azure: experiencia trabajando con servicios como Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid y Storage Queues/Blob Storage para construir arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración entre sistemas.

· Azure Key Vault y gestión segura de secretos, certificados y configuración sensible.

· Conocimiento de Managed Identities, Entra ID y OAuth2/OIDC para autenticación entre aplicaciones y servicios Azure.

· Experiencia trabajando con SQL Server / Azure SQL y acceso a datos desde .NET, idealmente utilizando Entity Framework Core.

· Conocimientos de Docker y containerización de aplicaciones .NET.

· Experiencia trabajando con Git y procesos de CI/CD, entendiendo cómo una aplicación pasa desde el código hasta los diferentes entornos.

· Experiencia real utilizando asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code o herramientas similares, no sólo para autocompletar código, sino como parte habitual del ciclo de desarrollo.

Esperamos que seas capaz de utilizar IA para generar, revisar, refactorizar, documentar y testear código, manteniendo siempre criterio técnico sobre lo que genera.

🔍
Nos suma mucho si además:

· Has trabajado con arquitecturas event-driven y patrones como Pub/Sub, queues, topics o asynchronous processing.

· Experiencia desplegando o desarrollando aplicaciones que se ejecutan sobre Kubernetes, trabajando con containers, configuración, secrets, health checks, scaling y troubleshooting básico.

· Conoces patrones de diseño de microservicios como API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Retry, Outbox, Saga o CQRS.

· Tienes experiencia con Azure Container Apps además de AKS.

· Has trabajado con Application Insights, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics para observabilidad y troubleshooting.

· Conocimientos de Azure API Management (APIM): publicación y consumo de APIs, policies, seguridad, versionado y gestión del ciclo de vida de las APIs.

· Conoces Redis / Azure Managed Redis y estrategias de caching.

· Has trabajado con Cosmos DB u otras bases de datos NoSQL.

· Entiendes conceptos de Infrastructure as Code, especialmente Terraform, aunque no esperamos que seas especialista.

· Has trabajado con Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions para CI/CD.

· Tienes experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios, de integración y contract tests.

· Has utilizado herramientas como SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk o similares para mejorar la calidad y seguridad del código.

· Has trabajado con Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Semantic Kernel o integración de modelos de IA dentro de aplicaciones.

· Has trabajado con MCP, agentes de desarrollo, skills, instrucciones de repositorio o workflows agentic para mejorar el contexto que reciben las herramientas de IA durante el desarrollo.

· Tienes formación técnica (Informática, Telecomunicaciones, etc.).

· Te manejas bien en inglés.

· Tienes alguna certificación oficial de Microsoft Azure.

🧠
¿Qué valoramos?

· Mentalidad de ingeniería: no buscamos únicamente a alguien que programe historias de usuario, sino que entienda cómo encaja su código dentro de la arquitectura completa.

· Capacidad para diseñar soluciones simples, mantenibles y preparadas para producción.

· Criterio para decidir cuándo utilizar un microservicio, una Function, una Logic App o cualquier otro servicio de Azure.

· Entender que la IA acelera el desarrollo, pero no sustituye el criterio técnico.

· Capacidad para revisar críticamente el código generado por herramientas de IA y detectar problemas de arquitectura, seguridad, rendimiento o mantenibilidad.

· Mentalidad API-first y cloud-native.

· Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: clean code, testing, observabilidad y seguridad desde el diseño.

· Ganas de aportar, trabajar en equipo y seguir aprendiendo.

· Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.

· Curiosidad por cómo la IA generativa y los agentes están transformando el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

🌟
¿Por qué unirte a BIP?

· Personas primero: valoramos tu talento y tu equilibrio personal.

· Entorno ágil y flexible: trabajamos en remoto y con horarios que se adaptan a ti.

· Formación cont
inua: tendrás acceso a cursos top en tecnología e innovación.

· Proyectos con impacto: trabajarás con empresas líderes construyendo plataformas, APIs, microservicios e integraciones sobre Azure.

· Desarrollo aumentado por IA: queremos que herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude Code formen parte de tu día a día y que nos ayudes a evolucionar nuestra forma de desarrollar software.

· Un equipo que suma: buen ambiente, colaboración real y cero postureo.

📩
¿Y ahora qué?

Si te interesa, mándanos tu CV. Lo revisaremos con cariño y si encajas, te contactaremos.

Si ahora no es el momento, pero crees que encajarías en el futuro, también nos encantará tenerte en el radar.

 Bip Iberia, en compromiso y coherencia con la Ley Integral para la Igualdad de Trato y la No discriminación tiene abiertas todas las posiciones de búsqueda de perfiles a todas aquellas personas que estén debidamente cualificadas para cubrir la vacante, independientemente de su edad, discapacidad, género, orientación sexual o política, raza o creencia.
 BUSINESS INTEGRATION PARTNERS CONSULTING IBERIA, S.L., con NIF B84701903 y contacto Liliana.mendoza@bip-group.com tratará los datos recibidos al aplicar su candidatura en la oferta como Responsable del tratamiento, con la finalidad de gestionar el proceso de selección actualmente activo en base a la aplicación de medidas precontractuales del artículo 6.1. b) del GDPR, así como para futuros procesos de selección si su perfil fuera de interés, en base al consentimiento del artículo 6.1 a).
 BUSINESS INTEGRATION PARTNERS CONSULTING IBERIA, S.L. no comunicará sus datos a terceros salvo obligación legal. Así mismo, el periodo de conservación de su CV será como máximo de 1 año, tras el cual será destruido.
 Igualmente puede ejercer sus derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición, limitación al tratamiento, portabilidad y a no ser objeto de decisiones individualizadas automatizadas, así como consultar información adicional sobre el tratamiento, en el correo: dpo-bipspain@bip-group.com.

Connect is where hotel supply from hundreds of suppliers becomes one clean API that partners build on: how we connect to suppliers, price and serve inventory at scale, and make fragmented travel data usable in real time.

You'll work across the full lifecycle, building new capabilities and scaling the systems partners rely on every day. You'll go from idea to production without detailed specs, and you'll be accountable for whether what you ship creates real value.

The problem is hard: latency, correctness, cost and supplier limits all pull in different directions, and the product decisions can't be separated from the technical ones.

What makes it interesting for you:

You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape and teams make their own product decisions. A good idea in the morning can be in production by the evening, and many iterations ship in days rather than months.
You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there, including when to say no.
You get genuinely hard engineering problems. Caching, multi-supplier pricing, data pipelines, and routing under strict latency budgets all interact in real time.
You'll shape how we build. We got to roughly €1B in booking value with a lean team. Now we're building the next phase of the platform as we push toward €10B, and you'll help set the engineering and product standards.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you’ll work on:

How do we take fragmented, inconsistent data from hundreds of suppliers and serve it reliably through a clean API?
How do we cache and deliver a pricing matrix covering 100k+ hotels so partners can use it in real time?
How do we answer multi-supplier rate requests within strict latency budgets, route to the best suppliers, and protect supplier QPS and system stability under load?
How do we harmonize data across suppliers (room mapping, for example), including with LLM-assisted approaches?

You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out.
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.

This role fits someone who:

Is a senior and hands-on backend engineer, ideally with experience in Go (but we’re also interested in people from C#, Java, C++ or similar backgrounds who want to pick up Go).
Has built products or major features from scratch.
Thinks in terms of outcomes and user value, not just implementation.
Is comfortable working without clear specs or structure.
Can make pragmatic tradeoffs and move fast.
Has experience with APIs, data-heavy systems, or distributed environments.
Takes ownership beyond their scope and pushes things forward.

Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.

If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

What are we looking for now?

A Staff-level engineer who has done this before: someone who can walk into a mature, high-scale platform, understand where AI genuinely moves the needle versus where it's just noise, and lead the engineering work to get it done. You're comfortable being the most senior technical voice in the room, but you'd rather be pairing with an engineer on a gnarly integration than sitting in a strategy deck all day. You think in systems, not scripts: production reliability, data quality, and security aren't afterthoughts to you, they're the job.

This isn't a research role. It's a build role, with the freedom and seniority to also set direction.

What You'll Do

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for AI adoption across Valsea's product, platform, and internal tooling, grounded in what's actually feasible on our stack, not slideware.
Architect and lead the delivery of AI-powered capabilities into our Scala/Go/Kafka backend, from recommendation and personalisation to support/fraud/risk signals, agentic automation, and internal developer tooling.
Set the vision and roadmap for agentic QA automation (using AI agents to expand test coverage, catch regressions earlier, and reduce manual QA load) and for AI-accelerated support and incident response that cuts time-to-detect and time-to-resolve.
Introduce AI tooling at the root of our SDLC pipelines (GitHub/GitLab: code review, testing, deployment gates), so AI assistance is built into how the team ships, not bolted on afterward.
Evaluate and integrate LLM and ML infrastructure (self-hosted and API-based), making pragmatic build-vs-buy calls that respect our scale, latency, and cost constraints.
Set Product Development standards for how AI features get designed, tested, monitored, and rolled back. Model-driven systems should meet the same rigour as any other production service.
Partner directly with Engineering leadership, Product, and Data to identify where AI creates real player or business value, and turn that into a delivery plan.
Act as a technical multiplier: mentor senior and mid-level engineers and managers, run design reviews, and raise the technical bar for how the wider team thinks about AI-assisted and AI-driven systems.
Stay hands-on: prototype fast, get into the codebase, and unblock hard integration and performance problems yourself when it matters.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in the JVM/Scala ecosystem (or a comparably strong background in a statically-typed, distributed-systems-heavy language) plus proven Staff/Principal-level scope: setting technical direction, not just executing it.
Hands-on experience shipping AI/ML-powered features into production at real scale, with real users: LLM integration, recommendation systems, applied ML, or agentic infrastructure.
Deep comfort with event-driven, distributed architectures (Akka/Pekko, Kafka or equivalent); you understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.
Strong, hands-on experience with distributed systems and container orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, and the operational patterns that come with running them at scale.
A track record of making sound build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including around cost, latency, data privacy, and vendor risk for AI systems specifically.
Product-minded: you think in terms of player impact and business outcomes, not just technical elegance.
A strong communicator who can move fluidly between a whiteboard architecture discussion with engineers and a plain-language case for leadership.
You thrive in ambiguity: this role starts with a mandate, not a spec, and you'll help write the spec.
Proficiency in professional-level English communication, written and verbal.

Nice To Have

Please note, these aren't requirements, just things we think would be particularly valuable. If anything or everything here doesn't apply to you, please don't let that put you off applying.

Good domain knowledge of entertainment or another regulated, high-throughput consumer platform is recommended.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
Background running or scaling self-hosted AI/LLM infrastructure and observability.
Exposure to fraud detection, risk scoring, or trust & safety systems.
Experience introducing AI tooling into an engineering organization's own workflows (dev tooling, code review, incident response), not just into the product.
Modern MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.

What We Offer

Hybrid working model from our office in Marbella (3 days/week) or fully remote (EU)
Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
Competitive salary with flexible working hours
23 paid vacation days + public holidays
Private health insurance for you and your family
Free Online English/Spanish lessons
Corporate events throughout the year
Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

In-office Perks Such As

Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://valsea.teamtailor.com/data-privacy) to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

We’re a diverse team with great people from across the world. This position is available both as a hybrid position in Marbella (Spain) or as a fully remote position from inside the EU. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work visas outside the EU.

Experiência em ambientes colaborativos, com equipas multidisciplinares e/ou globais.

In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our DICENTIS conference devices
. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately 30% to 80–90% of real device behavior
.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on both Windows and Linux
and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During Your Internship, You Will

Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using C# and/or C++.
Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
Make the simulator compatible with both Windows and Linux.
Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

Qualifications

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid programming skills in C# and/or C++.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It Is a Plus If You Have

Experience with .NET or .NET Core.
Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
Experience with automated testing or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
An interest in audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices.

Close guidance from experienced professionals.
A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Design Architect
new_jobs.description:
Overview

At PepsiCo International dCommerce team, we are building the next generation of innovative products and capabilities using emerging technologies to accelerate our business and gain back share. While tied closely to broader PepsiCo, the dCommerce group has a unique start-up feel and defined values that embrace a more entrepreneurial mindset.

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to guide the technical direction of our engineering organization as we scale. From evolving our data platform to transitioning to software, from BI tooling into a full application and AI for BI, you'll lead architecture and design reviews, define integration approaches with wider PepsiCo capabilities, and ensure we build coherently across Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product Engineering.

This is a role for someone who wants to build the blueprint, not just inherit one. You'll partner with Engineering Managers to make technology choices that balance innovation with pragmatism, navigate platform governance to unblock delivery, and ensure what we build today supports where we're heading. If you want to shape the technical future of a scaling digital commerce capability not just review other people's designs - this is that opportunity.

Responsibilities

Architecture and Design Oversight

Lead software architecture and design reviews across the International Digital cCmmerce engineering organization, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and long-term goals
Define and maintain reference architectures for dComm capabilities from data platform through to user-facing applications
Ensure architectural coherence across Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product Engineering
Participate in creating the the architectural runway in collaboration with Platform team by identifying foundational investments needed to support future capabilities

Platform and Integration Strategy

Lead evaluation and design of integration approaches with wider PepsiCo capabilities and platforms relevant for International
Partner with DTX Core Platform Team to ensure dComm needs are represented in platform decisions
Navigate platform governance, submit requests, advocate for international requirements, ensure dComm isn't blocked by platform constraints
Advise on AI for BI evolution

Technical Leadership

Partner with Product Engineering Manager on application architecture decisions: technology selection, system design, scalability approach
Provide architectural guidance on complex cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams
Review and challenge technical designs to ensure they meet non-functional requirements (performance, security, maintainability)

Standards and Governance

Define and maintain software architecture standards for dComm: API design, service boundaries, security patterns, deployment approaches
Ensure alignment with wider PepsiCo technology standards while advocating for dComm-specific needs
Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts
Guide Engineering Managers on architectural trade-offs and help them make informed decisions

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary architectural interface between dComm and DTX Core Platform Team
Collaborate with Data Architect to ensure end-to-end coherence across data and application layers
Represent dComm engineering in enterprise architecture forums and technology governance processes
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risks, and architectural implications of strategic initiatives

Qualifications

6+ years of experience as a solutions architect spanning data platforms and applications
Experience navigating enterprise platform teams and governance processes
Background in integration architecture connecting capabilities across organizational boundaries
Strong software architecture foundation system design, API design, service-oriented and event-driven architectures
Experience with modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow) and how applications integrate with data platforms
Strong expertise in containerization technologies and container orchestration solutions
Ability to create and maintain architecture diagramas to effectively communicate system design/technical decisions
Understanding of cloud cost optimization, with the ability to balance cost, performance and business value in architectural decisions.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and infrastructure considerations
Understanding of BI tools (Power BI) and their architectural limitations
Experience with or strong interest in Elixir (or comparable functional languages for scalable applications)
Knowledge of security, performance, and scalability patterns for enterprise applications
Ability to guide and influence Engineering Managers without direct authority
Strong communication skills and can articulate architectural rationale to technical and business audiences
Comfortable operating in a matrix environment across dComm, DTX Platform, and enterprise functions

What makes us different?

Hybrid work model: combination of remote and collaborative office experience to enable innovation
Entrepreneurial environment in leading international company
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing
Volunteering opportunities to help external communities

About PepsiCo

We believe that culture should be at the cornerstone of everything we do at PepsiCo. We are agile, innovative and not afraid of failure. We want our team to come to work every day excited to explore new ways to bring enjoyment, refreshment and fun to the world.

PepsiCo Positive (pep+) is the future of our organization – a strategic end-to-end transformation, with sustainability at the center of how we will create growth and value by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for the planet and people.

So, if you’re ready to be a part of a playground for those who think big, we’d love to chat.

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability
